in_marathi.name: Deeptimoy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Deep in knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeptimoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deeps (Deep) in knowledge (Moy) or 'Lord of deep knowledge'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' meaning deep and 'Moy' meaning knowledge or wisdom.
